basket.en: Standard private-room allowance for two adults, rounded from three Belfast room observations for 28–30 November 2026 (£125–£136.50 per night, taxes and fees shown included). Not bookable inventory; other dates, room types and cancellation terms can cost more.
basket.sq: Shumë për dhomë private standarde për dy të rritur, e rrumbullakosur nga tri vëzhgime në Belfast për 28–30 nëntor 2026 (£125–£136.50 për natë, me taksat dhe tarifat e shfaqura). Jo inventar për rezervim; datat, dhomat dhe anulimi mund të kushtojnë më shumë.

components.methodology: Normal Expedia UI, 28–30 November, two adults/one room: Tara Lodge entry Deluxe Double £250 total; Holiday Inn Express standard double £273 total (search initially £282); Aloft queen £269 total. Non-refundable; displayed taxes/fees included; breakfast not uniformly included. Nightly range £125–£136.50, median £134.50, rounded upward to £140. No luxury suites/dorms, login or checkout. Queens/Titanic quarters. Small sample, not a city-wide market median.

basket.en: Rounded adult daily basket: light breakfast, burger lunch with fries and a soft drink, casual dinner and two extra soft drinks. Based on Harlem and Bunsen menu examples, not a city average or a promise of every meal. Breakfast included in a room may reduce spending.
basket.sq: Shumë ditore e rrumbullakosur për të rritur: mëngjes i lehtë, hamburger me patate dhe pije, darkë e thjeshtë dhe dy pije shtesë. Bazuar në shembuj nga menutë Harlem dhe Bunsen, jo mesatare qyteti apo garanci për çdo vakt. Mëngjesi i përfshirë në dhomë mund ta ulë shpenzimin.

components.methodology: Illustrative basket: Harlem granola £10.95; Bunsen cheeseburger £9.45, fries £3.95, soda £2.50; Harlem casual dinner £18.95; two further sodas £5. Total £50.80 rounded to £55. Two businesses, not a city average. Harlem dinner example Saturday-only; choices vary. No alcohol/assumed service charge. Included hotel breakfast can lower actual spending.

basket.en: One adult mLink Metro/Glider day ticket per person per day. City network only; airport journeys separate. Child discounts are not modelled.
basket.sq: Një biletë ditore mLink Metro/Glider për të rritur për person në ditë. Vetëm rrjeti urban; aeroporti llogaritet veç. Uljet për fëmijë nuk modelohen.

BFS Airport Express 300 monthly return £11 verified on current mLink page. City Airport confirms route 600 but no current fare; older Translink fare URL returns 404. BHD coverage and city-pass overlap unresolved. Do not universalize BFS £11 or count a covered airport ride twice; arrival stays general.

basket.en: £10 per person per night toward optional paid sightseeing. Two nights reserve £20, informed by Crumlin Road Gaol's £18.50 adult admission. One night provides only a contribution. Free sightseeing has no admission allowance charged to it.
basket.sq: £10 për person për natë për vizita fakultative me pagesë. Dy net japin £20, bazuar në hyrjen £18.50 për të rritur në Crumlin Road Gaol. Një natë mbulon vetëm një pjesë. Shëtitjet falas nuk llogariten si hyrje me pagesë.

components.methodology: Crumlin Road Gaol adult self-guided admission £18.50. £10/person/night gives £20 for two nights toward one optional visit. One-night allowance only a contribution; free sightseeing remains free.
